record.offering: Lifestyle app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Your AI outfit maker.
Your closet — now you can talk to it.
Pronti is an AI outfit maker and closet organizer that helps you get dressed faster using the clothes you already own. With PAI, your closet-aware AI stylist, you can chat about outfits, plan what to wear, and get real fashion advice — grounded in your actual wardrobe.
It’s like having a stylist in your pocket… or Cher’s iconic closet, upgraded with AI.

An AI stylist that uses your actual wardrobe
PAI isn’t a generic fashion chatbot. It understands your closet items, saved outfits, and style history, so when you ask what to wear, the advice actually makes sense.
You can ask PAI things like:
What can I wear today with my black blazer?
Style my white sneakers for dinner.
Help me pack outfits for a weekend trip.
This is AI you can talk to about outfits — powered by your own wardrobe.

Generate outfits from your real closet
Upload your clothes using photos or online images. Pronti learns your style and creates outfit ideas you’ll actually wear — no more staring at your closet wondering what goes together.
Mornings are easier with an AI outfit maker built around your wardrobe.

Closet uploads are easy
Take a photo
Use your phone’s Gallery
Add items from store images or Google
Take a selfie
Forward emails with your shopping purchases

Built-in outfit planner & style diary
Plan outfits ahead and track what you wore, how it looked, and what worked. Over time, Pronti becomes a smarter outfit planner and style journal that helps you understand your personal style.

Get inspired by the community
See how others style their outfits and discover new ways to wear the clothes you already own.

Make fashion more sustainable
Rediscover forgotten clothes. Create more outfits without buying more. Pronti helps reduce outfit anxiety and encourages smarter, more intentional dressing.

Shop smarter, dress better
When you do shop, Pronti recommends pieces that actually fit your wardrobe and style — helping you buy less, but better.

Why users love Pronti
AI stylist that uses your real closet
Chat-based outfit advice you can trust
Easy outfit planning and wardrobe organization
Outfit diary to track what works
Smarter shopping with personalized recommendations

Pronti is free to use and supported by shoppable links, ads, and optional Premium features. When you shop through the app, we may earn a commission — at no cost to you. Your data stays private and secure.

Pronti: Less stress, more style.
Get dressed faster. Wear what you love.
Talk to your closet like never before.

BUILD YOUR DIGITAL WARDROBE

Easily add clothes from a photo, multiple images or the web. DressUp can automatically remove backgrounds and recognize details such as category, color, fabric and season.

Organize clothes and outfits into custom lists, track your wardrobe completion and quickly find what you need.

PERSONALIZED OUTFITS WITH AI

Choose a dress code or describe the occasion and let DressUp combine your clothes into new looks. Rate the results to help the app better understand your taste.

Generate multiple suggestions, save your favorites and continue using the app while outfits are created in the background.

PLAN WHAT TO WEAR

Use the Planner to organize daytime and evening outfits for the coming days or let AI plan an entire week for you.

Going on a trip? AI Suitcase creates outfits based on your destination, travel dates, weather and planned activities.

DISCOVER YOUR STYLE

Get personalized advice from AI Stylist, discover your most flattering colors with color analysis and use Recreate a Look to reinterpret an inspiration outfit with clothes from your own wardrobe.

TRY ON YOUR LOOKS VIRTUALLY

See clothes and outfits on your avatar with Virtual Try-On and get an instant visual preview of your look.

STATISTICS AND GOALS

Discover which clothes and colors you wear most, understand your habits, complete goals and make better use of everything you already own.

DressUp is made for anyone who loves fashion, wants to simplify everyday choices and get more from their wardrobe.

Your style, your wardrobe, every day.

HeyBabe is an AI companion app where every chat turns into a story. Meet a whole cast of AI characters — each with their own personality, mood, and a story that goes where you take it.

HeyBabe is a mobile app for AI character chat and interactive storytelling. It gives you a growing cast of AI girlfriends and original characters across distinct moods — slow burn, gentle and caring, fantasy and mystery, strong and in control — with memory that carries between conversations and branching scenarios you steer yourself.

NOT ONE CHARACTER. A WHOLE CAST.
Dozens of AI characters, each with a name, a background, and a way of talking that's actually their own. Browse by mood, find the one you click with, and start from there. New characters are added regularly.

EVERY CHARACTER. A DIFFERENT VIBE.
Slow burn. Gentle and caring. Fantasy and mystery. Strong and in control. Pick the energy you're in the mood for — the same question gets a different answer depending on who you ask.

This isn't question-and-answer. Conversations build: a first message becomes a scene, a scene becomes a plot, and your character remembers how it started.

Secret date, last train, lost city, a masked performance — pick a scenario and play it out. Change your mind halfway and the story follows you.

THEY REMEMBER YOU
Your characters keep what matters: what you told them last week, what you avoid talking about, the running joke you started on day one. Come back after a month and pick up where you left off.

CHAT IN YOUR LANGUAGE, ANY TIME
HeyBabe works in English, German, French, Spanish, Portuguese, and more, around the clock. Whether it's two minutes on a commute or two hours at 3 a.m.

YOUR CHATS STAY YOURS
Conversations are private to your account. We don't sell your chat data and we don't use it to advertise to you.

record.description_evidence:
Hedge fund analysts don't beat you because they're smarter. They beat you because they have systems you've never been able to access. Barebone rebuilds those systems as AI agents. Ask one question and a team of analysts researches the company, the chart, the risk, and the smart money in seconds, not hours.

The edge was always theirs. Now it's yours.

Built by ex-Goldman Sachs bankers. Trusted by 30,000+ investors. Top 100 Apple Finance on day one.

ASK ANYTHING, GET INSTITUTIONAL RESEARCH
• Ask anything in plain English on stocks, ETFs, crypto, forex, commodities, and indices, and get a full answer in under a minute
• Barebone runs proprietary quantitative algorithms alongside the AI, so the hard numbers are computed, not guessed
• 20+ specialized research agents, 11+ analyst models, 70+ institutional data sources
• A quality rating broken into four readable scores: growth, business quality, financial health, and valuation
• Exact entry, exit, and stop-loss prices, computed by algorithm across five timeframes from support, resistance, RSI, and trend
• Every number cross-checked against the raw financials before you see it

TRACK THE SMART MONEY
• See what U.S. Congress members buy and sell, with 1-year history
• Follow corporate insider trades straight from official filings
• Mirror legendary super investors' 13F portfolios
• Institutional ownership and conviction signals

KNOW WHAT'S COMING AT EARNINGS
• Live prediction-market odds on whether a company beats
• Expected move and EPS beat/miss history before every report

REAL-TIME MARKET INTELLIGENCE
• AI market brief every morning
• Global news across 10 regions, every story ranked by how hard it could move your stocks, so you skip the noise
• Trending tickers, earnings and economic calendars

YOUR PORTFOLIO, WATCHED 24/7
• Connect your brokerage or add holdings manually
• Live P&L plus risk metrics: volatility, Sharpe, beta, drawdown
• A 5-analyst AI review of your entire portfolio
• Alerts the moment something moves

IT LEARNS YOU
• Remembers your style and scales every answer from beginner to trading-desk depth
• Available in English, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese

BAREBONE PRO
Unlock unlimited research, full smart-money tracking (Congress, insiders, super investors), the 5-analyst portfolio review, and AI-scored news. Free to start.

HOW BAREBONE IS DIFFERENT
A chatbot makes things up and can't see live filings or your portfolio. A trading app places orders but won't tell you what's worth doing. Barebone does the institutional research and the monitoring, then leaves the decision to you. No conflict, no order flow, no noise.

IMPORTANT
Barebone is a research and education tool. It does not provide investment, financial, or legal advice and does not execute trades. AI output can contain errors. Always verify and make your own decisions.

Barebone Pro is an auto-renewing subscription. Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase. Manage or turn off auto-renew anytime in account settings under Manage Subscription. Any unused portion of a free trial is forfeited on purchase.

cred.ai is a high-tech and premium everyday card spending experience, 100% mobile with a free metal card. With the cred.ai guaranty you never pay fees or interest, never overspend, build credit automatically*, and spend your paycheck early**, with cutting edge tech you can’t get anywhere else like Check Please™ and Flux Capacitor.  100% mobile, 24/7 support, real-time control, and virtual Digital Cards active instantly upon approval. •giving credit where credit is due • 
Your metal unicorn card is a real credit card, but cred.ai™ automation and the cred.ai™ guaranty makes sure you never pay fees or interest and never overspend, and automatically manages your balances to optimize your credit utilization. Spend like you’re using a debit card, and build your credit* like a pro.

• imagine if tony stark built a bank • 
cred.ai™ is a team of builders, scientists, artists, and hackers.  That’s why we have exclusive features like Timer Mode, Friend & Foe List™, Digital Card, Check Please™, and Flux Capacitor.  This is the most cutting edge way to spend every day.

• won’t break the bank, but could break a window • 
The Unicorn Card weighs more than those other fancy black cards, but you don’t pay a fee to get it.  We think it’s the best looking unicorn themed free metal card on earth, but that’s just us.

• the card you carry is metal, but digital card is bulletproof • 
Digital Card is for your more sketch transactions, like ordering pizza over the phone, corn sites, or signing up for free trials.  Regenerate Digital Card when you feel unsafe, or use them in Timer Mode for ultimate protection.  Use your Digital Card online, over the phone, and in person via your phone’s mobile wallet.

• original content from crednews • 
crednews™ is a team of award winning journalists producing original content about topics we think are important.  Why would a fintech make documentaries about UBI and psilocybin? Because we can.

• your bank should never be a piggy • 
Access the spending power of your paycheck and other deposits up to two days before they even hit.** Get cash at over 55,000 free ATMs*** make instant deposits and mobile check deposits at no fee, and all deposits are FDIC insured up to $250,000†.  Use Flux Capacitor to automatically protect yourself against future charges and withdrawals.

• boring but true •

○ 24/7 Phones Answered By Humans
○ 55,000+ Free ATMs***
○ Deposits FDIC Insured Up To $250,000†
○ We Will Never Share Your Data
○ PCI DSS & EI3PA Certified

†cred.ai is a financial technology company, not a bank. The cred.ai Deposit Account is provided by WSFS Bank, Member FDIC. Deposits are insured up to $250,000 per depositor. The Unicorn Card credit card is issued by WSFS Bank pursuant to a license from Visa® U.S.A. Inc. and may be used everywhere Visa® credit cards are accepted.

Fina is the finance app that respects your intelligence — and your privacy.

AI handles the tedious parts. You stay in control.

POWERED BY AI

Just tell Fina what you spent. Type "Lunch 12", say "coffee $4.50", or photograph a receipt — Fina's AI instantly parses the amount, category, and note. No manual entry. No form filling. Just talk, and it's logged.

Ask Fina questions like "How much did I spend on dining last month?" and get answers, not spreadsheets.

YOUR DATA STAYS YOURS

Everything is stored locally on your device. iCloud Sync works privately — no third-party servers ever see your transactions. We don't collect, sell, or analyze your financial data. Ever.

Lock the app with Face ID, Touch ID, or a PIN for an extra layer of protection.

EVERYTHING YOU NEED - FREE

Expense & income tracking. Custom categories with icons and colors. Monthly budgets with real-time alerts. Spending charts and breakdowns. iCloud Sync across devices. CSV and JSON export.

All of it. No subscription required.

Fina Pro unlocks unlimited AI usage for power users — but the core app is fully functional for free, forever.

INSIGHTS THAT ACTUALLY HELP

Bar charts, donut charts, and monthly summaries show exactly where your money goes. Switch between weekly, monthly, and yearly views. Tap any category to see every transaction behind it.
